secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (e.g. https://<project>.supabase.co). Already set to the project URL from next.config.ts; override only if the project changes.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable key from your Supabase dashboard (Settings → API). Needed for client-side auth and data fetching.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key from your Supabase dashboard (Settings → API). Used by server-side API routes for payments, tickets, and streaming.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (same as NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL). Used by some server-side API routes.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_AGORA_APP_ID
secrets.description: Agora App ID from the Agora console. Needed for live streaming features.

secrets.name: AGORA_APP_CERTIFICATE
secrets.description: Agora App Certificate from the Agora console. Needed for generating streaming tokens server-side.

secrets.name: FAPSHI_API_USER
secrets.description: Fapshi API username for mobile money payments. Optional — defaults to empty string.

secrets.name: FAPSHI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Fapshi API key for mobile money payments. Optional — defaults to empty string.
